content.title: Thomas Markle Faces Child Sexual Abuse Material Charges
content.caption: Thomas Markle, 82-year-old estranged father of the Duchess of Sussex, faces charges of keeping child sexual abuse material in storage.

slides.heading: Thomas Markle Faces Child Sexual Abuse Material Charges
slides.text: Thomas Markle, 82-year-old estranged father of the Duchess of Sussex, faces charges of keeping child sexual abuse material in storage.

slides.heading: Child Sexual Abuse Material Seized
slides.text: Approximately 78 items were seized from two storage units rented by Markle in the Los Angeles area, including slides, film negatives, and books containing suspected child sexual abuse images.
